prerequisites: Basic knowledge of C or C++ programming language

learning_outcomes.text: Students learn the fundamental algorithms for the efficient implementation of computationally intensive cryptographic procedures.
Students have understood the handling of algorithms with very long operands.
Students have understood the interaction of implementation methods and cryptographic security.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to procedures for fast and secure implementation of cryptographic algorithms
Special acceleration procedures for the RSA algorithm
Basic methods for representing arbitrary-precision numbers in computers
Procedures for addition of arbitrary-precision numbers
Introduction to active and passive side-channel attacks
Active attacks against block ciphers and RSA
assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of 30% (+10% bonus) from semester-long programming assignments and 70% from a written exam (120 minutes). Credits are awarded for a passed module examination.
